identity.title: Make Wuji Guardian startup and config reload converge

values.task_boundary: Runtime v3 and CSM operator startup/reload reliability only.
deliverables: Focused regression tests and Wuji readiness proof
acceptance_criteria: A single CSM start invocation reaches stable Runtime HTTPS readiness on 20997
Ordinary startup does not depend on a separate port-20998 continuity handshake
CSM exposes start, stop, status, and validated config reload/restart
Ownerless locks and interrupted startup journals reconcile automatically without discarding Polis state
A genuine live writer is still rejected
The host service manager keeps Wuji running and restarts it after failure
Focused local tests pass and local plus AWS-facing health is verified
non_goals: Discarding or resetting retained Wuji state
Weakening Guardian authority or live-writer exclusion
Changing public API or WSS route semantics
